value.rationale: Unit-stoichiometric multicomponent assembly naturally produces a vector of leftover spectator counts after a shared bottleneck. Pair covariance rather than mean yield measures whether leftover species compete or co-fluctuate. This rigorous high-loading four-to-five change and finite-loading reversal expose a nontrivial physical correlation boundary, not a cosmetic reformulation of the known mean matching deficit.
